$comment: Descriptions for the docs tables (src/docs.ts), keyed by token id. Not a token set: the resolver does not read it. Every color token has one here, since the theme files are per brand; any other token takes its $description from the token JSON, or from here when the JSON has none, never both.

descriptions.color.fg-soft: Placeholder and locked text; at least 4.5:1
descriptions.color.fg-disabled: Disabled controls; exempt from contrast minimums (WCAG 1.4.3)
descriptions.color.brand-fg: Text on the brand tint, and links
descriptions.color.success: Success icons and shapes, at 3:1 on bg-canvas and bg-raised; not for text, which uses success-fg. Feedback and grades only
descriptions.color.success-fg: Success text, on its tint or the canvas
descriptions.color.warning: Warning icons and shapes, at 3:1 on bg-canvas and bg-raised; not for text, which uses warning-fg. Feedback and grades only
descriptions.color.warning-fg: Warning text, on its tint or the canvas
descriptions.color.danger: Danger icons and shapes, at 3:1 on bg-canvas and bg-raised; not for text, which uses danger-fg. Feedback and grades only
descriptions.color.danger-fg: Danger text, on its tint or the canvas
descriptions.color.info: Info icons and shapes, at 3:1 on bg-canvas and bg-raised; not for text, which uses info-fg. Feedback and grades only
descriptions.color.info-fg: Info text, on its tint or the canvas
descriptions.color.state-locked: Learning state locked: icons and shapes, at 3:1 on bg-canvas and bg-raised; not for text
descriptions.color.state-available: Learning state available: icons and shapes, at 3:1 on bg-canvas and bg-raised; not for text
descriptions.color.state-progress: Learning state in progress: icons and shapes, at 3:1 on bg-canvas and bg-raised; not for text
